Readme for testpoint: 256R002

A problem occurred with the MDCA color camera.
Only 94 images were archived.
The images end at about the time of ignition.
Included on the DVD is the video image captured from ISS video using the color camera.
File is named _ISS_20090625_153031_256R002.mpg.

3mm droplet manually dispensed and stretched.
Total fuel dispensed was 8085 counts.
Total fuel burnt was 1069 counts.
